newsitem.title: USA: Manpower sees 1997 year EPS of $2.10/shr.
newsitem.headline: Manpower sees 1997 year EPS of $2.10/shr.

text.p: Manpower Inc Treasurer Mike Van Handel projected that 1997 earnings per share would be $2.10.

Van Handel acknowledged in a presentation to the Atlanta Society of Financial Analysts that this prediction is below the $2.15 per share earnings being forecasted by a consensus of Wall Street analysts.
The analysts' range is $2.10 to $2.35 per share.

Van Handel said that analysts at the high-end of the range seem to be bullish on the company's prospects in France, the second most important market for the Milwaukee-based provider of temporary help services.
"We are right now very positive (about France) but it is still a little to early to call," he said.
Manpower suffered a below par year in France in 1996 until the fourth quarter when business picked up by 12 percent, Van Handel said.
